title: Reverse Probing: Supervised Token-level Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models in Clinical Text
abstract: arXiv:2605.28740v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As large language models are increasingly deployed for clinical text, ensuring they can reliably signal their own uncertainty becomes critical. Most existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods are designed for open-domain generation and cannot localize uncertainty at the token or span level in long clinical text. We propose Reverse Probing, the first UQ framework specialized for clinical summarization, which estimates token-level uncertainty directly from pre-existing labeled summaries. Rather than sampling new outputs, Reverse Probing treats the text as a probe into the model's internal state, extracting uncertainty signals from four categories of internal activations. We evaluate on two expert-annotated clinical datasets and outperform eight adapted baselines on all metrics, achieving up to 4 times higher AUPRC while reducing inference time and computational costs. translated_title: 反向探测：面向临床文本中大语言模型的有监督词元级不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被部署用于临床文本，确保它们能够可靠地表达自身的不确定性变得至关重要。现有的大多数不确定性量化（UQ）方法是为开放域生成设计的，无法在长篇临床文本中将不确定性定位到词元或片段级别。我们提出了反向探测，这是首个专门用于临床摘要的不确定性量化框架，它直接从已有的标注摘要中估计词元级的不确定性。反向探测无需采样新的输出，而是将文本作为探查模型内部状态的探针，从四类内部激活中提取不确定性信号。我们在两个由专家标注的临床数据集上进行评估，在所有指标上均优于八个适配的基线方法，AUPRC最高提升4倍，同时降低了推理时间和计算成本。特征分析显示，delta能量与邻近信息（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了首个面向临床摘要的词元级不确定性量化框架“反向探测”，无需采样新输出，直接利用已有标注摘要从模型四类内部激活中提取不确定性信号，在专家标注的临床数据集上以更低的推理时间和计算成本实现了最高4倍的AUPRC提升。
en_tdlr: Reverse Probing, the first UQ framework specialized for clinical summarization, estimates token-level uncertainty directly from pre-existing labeled summaries by probing the model's internal activations, outperforming eight adapted baselines with up to 4x higher AUPRC while reducing inference time and computational costs.
